investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC as inflation-protection hedge against PPI surprise cycle; Fed pivot to cuts delayed by wage-driven core inflation will compress yields and real rates, supporting BTC technicals near $80K support.

CoinDesk BTC fall below $80K is capitulation-level liquidity test; historically precedes 20-30% recoveries in prior cycles
US political uncertainty (Trump lawsuit vs. California over voter rolls, midterm election control) increases macro hedging demand for non-correlated assets
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed could maintain hawkish stance longer; PPI beat may trigger further rate hike expectations, compressing BTC risk appetite and extending sub-$80K period.
investment_theses.expression: Long 2x levered BTC perpetual futures on Deribit or Bybit; pairs trade: BTC vs. long US 10Y yields to hedge duration risk
